source.note: Wave-1 row 59 named the Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs Triceratops on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is the same Quaternius dinosaur pack (Dec 2018) from its itch.io page, CC0, the same zip as the t-rex. Height 3.0 m to the frill top in the rest pose, an adult Triceratops (about 3 m at the frill, hips ~2.4 m here); next to the t-rex (5.8 m to the head top) it stands about half as tall, as in the usual size charts. The model is stubby, so it is 6.5 m long against a real 8-9 m.
